title: PrivateBrowserPhoneService
responsibility: Accept an enrolled device’s sealed field only for the reviewed browser request and clear the plaintext after submission.

inputs.name: PrivateBrowserPhoneService.constructor.config
inputs.description: The executor gate, enrolled device repository, reviewed submit callback and optional clock.

inputs.name: PrivateBrowserPhoneService.offer.requestId
inputs.description: Identifier of the active private browser window.

inputs.name: PrivateBrowserPhoneService.offer.deviceId
inputs.description: Enrolled device assigned to that private browser window.

inputs.name: PrivateBrowserPhoneService.offer.scope
inputs.description: Reviewed executor, HTTPS origin, tab, field, recipe digest and action.

inputs.name: PrivateBrowserPhoneService.activeOffer.proof
inputs.description: An enrolled device proof signed for offer discovery with a fresh nonce and an empty JSON object as its payload.

inputs.name: PrivateBrowserPhoneService.submit.proof
inputs.description: An enrolled device proof signed for submission with the sealed field and every value bound by the offer.

outputs.name: privateBrowserPhonePaths
outputs.description: Fixed broker paths for signed offer discovery and sealed submission.

outputs.name: PrivateBrowserPhoneService.offer
outputs.description: A public offer with an ephemeral recipient key, or undefined when the private window or reviewed scope is unavailable.

outputs.name: PrivateBrowserPhoneService.activeOffer
outputs.description: A copy of the unexpired offer assigned to the proving device while its private window accepts input, or undefined.

outputs.name: PrivateBrowserPhoneService.submit
outputs.description: True after reviewed submission, private tab disposal and independent result verification. False for refusal or incomplete verification.

errors.name: VaultBrokerError
errors.description: An invalid, replayed or expired device proof, an unapproved device role, or a payload that is not an empty JSON object.
